description.value: Marina-side campground at the southern West Coast Trail trailhead, serving as a base for trophy salmon and halibut fishing, kayaking, and whale watching; open May to mid-October only, cash payment required, no reservations.

address.value: 7505 Gordon River Rd, Port Renfrew, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at portrenfrewmarina.com confirms a camping and marina facility at 7505 Gordon River Rd, Port Renfrew, BC with phone 250-483-1878; the OSM record omits 'Marina &' from the business name. The rates page explicitly states 'We don't accept reservations' (false) and lists ice for sale at the marina store (true); the local-info page names three food options in town (true). The website content references 2018/2019 dates throughout, raising concern about data currency, but no permanent closure is indicated.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Port Renfrew RV Park' but the business website consistently uses 'Port Renfrew Marina & RV Park'.
Website content appears significantly outdated — all pages reference years 2018 and 2019; current amenity details and operating status cannot be fully confirmed from this source alone.
Payment policy noted as cash only (no credit cards or Interac); an on-site ATM is mentioned, but this may affect cyclists carrying limited cash.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate established campground at the southern West Coast Trail trailhead — a natural stop for touring cyclists on the southern Vancouver Island loop. Website staleness warrants a manual check before publishing.
